summary: Sees Palmer Eldritch in the sun during the years of the Terrible Separation and later calls it a true vision of God, not just a fictional echo of The Three Stigmata of Palmer Eldritch.
notes: Dick explicitly links the episode to the 'Other Sun' and says it was one of the first moments when he could 'see God at all.'

summary: Sees a band of darkness crossing the sky with Laura and later reads it as a sign of Christ's death, the withdrawal of light, and the possibility of a mirrored light at night.
notes: This is the sky-vision that later gets folded into his Sun of Righteousness / third-eye thinking.
